blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These sentences and their English translations were written by people on Tatoeba (tatoeba.org), shared under CC BY 2.0 FR. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.prompt: Come, Emilia! Your father is waiting for you.
exercises.why: «по-»: пойти. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Мы ___ (поехать) просёлочной дорогой, чтобы избежать интенсивного движения.
exercises.prompt: We took a back road to avoid the heavy traffic.
exercises.why: «по-»: поехать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«по-»: повезти. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Мы ___ (полететь) в Тай в этом году.
exercises.prompt: This year, we'll be flying to Thailand.
exercises.why: «по-»: полететь. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«по-»: побежать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Let's swim out to the float.
exercises.why: «по-»: поплыть. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Where are you going to take me?
exercises.why: «по-»: повести. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: I'll carry this suitcase for you.
exercises.why: «по-»: понести. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: От лёгкого ветерка по поверхности пруда ___ (пойти) рябь.
exercises.prompt: A gentle wind made ripples on the surface of the pond.
exercises.why: «по-»: пойти. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: После смерти Джанет у её мужа напрочь ___ (поехать) крыша.
exercises.prompt: Since Janet died, her husband has really gone off the deep end.
exercises.why: «по-»: поехать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Мэри влюбилась в Тома, и весь мир ___ (полететь) кувырком.
exercises.prompt: Mary fell in love with Tom, and the whole world turned upside-down.
exercises.why: «по-»: полететь. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«по-»: побежать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я считаю, что мне просто неслыханно ___ (повезти).
exercises.prompt: I think I was just incredibly lucky.
exercises.why: «по-»: повезти. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«по-»: поплыть. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
